messages:
Sofia Martinez: Hey folks  first day! Sofia here (AE). Two blockers: I can't access the AE Playbook (permission denied) and HubSpot / Gong don't show up in my app launcher. Who should I ping to get temporary access so I can start shadowing tomorrow?

Ops IT: Welcome Sofia! Sorry about that. Can you file a quick provisioning ticket with this snippet or paste the ID here?
```
product: Sales apps
requester: Sofia Martinez
email: sofia.martinez@redwood.example
access: HubSpot (seat), Gong (seat), Drive: /Sales/Playbooks/AE-Playbook-2024 (read+download)
priority: high
needed-by: 2024-08-15
```
If you already did, drop the ticket ID and I'll triage immediately.

Sofia Martinez: Filed as REQ-7999. Also the playbook link returns "restricted" even when I'm signed in. I need the discovery cheat sheet and objection one-pager to prep for shadows.

Ops IT: Thanks. I see REQ-7999. Quick heads up: we hit the Gong seat cap for this pool this week (budgeted seats exhausted). Two options: 1) I can create a temporary read-only Drive export (PDF bundle) with the discovery + objections + 1-pager and give you a HubSpot "observer" invite so you can watch records but not edit, or 2) we escalate seat reallocation to Sales Ops for priority invite. Which do you prefer?

Ben (sales-ops): Hi Sofia  I can push a seat from the reserve if this is high priority for onboarding. Ops IT  can we reassign one Gong seat from the reserve (short-term) to REQ-7999? If not, temporary observer + playbook bundle is fine.

Ops IT: Ben  reserve seats are currently tied up for a customer pilot, so we can't reassign until EOD. Suggest workspace workaround for now. Sofia, I've uploaded a ZIP of the key docs to your Drive and dropped a read-only link to the Playbook PDFs: https://drive.redwood.company/sales/playbooks/ae_playbook_bundle_1748309999 (access: sofia.martinez@redwood.example). HubSpot observer invite sent. Gong invite pending until Ben confirms seat reassign.

Sofia Martinez: Got the PDF bundle and the HubSpot observer invite  thanks, opening now. Will that let me see the sequences and sample leads for shadowing?

Ben (sales-ops): As observer you can see records but not clone sequences. For shadowing that's fine; I'll clone a demo sequence into a shared "AE-shadow" folder and give you edit access to that copy when you have full HubSpot. For now, @Cara can create a sandbox lead on her side and add you to the meeting.

Cara (CS): Done  created "AE Shadow - Sofia" lead and added sample tasks (log call, create handoff). I also recorded a 10-min Loom covering the 3 common objections + handoff fields and linked it in the playbook bundle. If you want live review after shadow, ping me.

Ops IT: Ben  confirming we will allocate a Gong seat from the monthly pool at EOD if the pilot doesn't need it. I'll update REQ-7999 with the final status and send the Gong invite.

Sofia Martinez: This is excellent  I can start reading the PDFs and watching the Loom. Appreciate the quick workaround. If the Gong seat comes through later, perfect. See you on the shadow at 11am.

admin-bot: Welcome Sofia Martinez! Onboarding checklist created: /onboarding/checklists/sofia_martinez_1748309999. Tasks added: Accept HubSpot invite (observer), Review AE playbook bundle, Watch Loom: Objections (10m), Shadow at 11:00, Log first sandbox activity.

Ben (sales-ops): Great team. Sofia  one more tip: keep a local copy of the 2-page Discovery cheat so you can reference it on calls. I'll follow up after EOD about Gong seat.

Sofia Martinez: Will do  thanks everyone :tada:
